name: Understance
track: Track 2: The Agent That Can Explain Why

zetaris.role: The data layer. Three sources (understance_code, understance_git, understance_tests) and a Unified Semantic Layer (understance_usl.module, understance_links.dependency) that the agents read through the REST API, after a data quality rule runs inside Zetaris on every run.

meterless_nightshift.role: The AI provider. The Explainer's narrator calls the Meterless runtime; each receipt (id, routed model, privacy path, egress) is logged.

meterless_engine.feature: The owner's decisions, kept per repo in an append-only ledger, so an open question is asked once and recalled on every later run.
meterless_engine.verification: implements the Meterless H-MEM spec, verified with a pytest port of its core test cases.

data: sample_app/ is synthetic, written for this project inside the build window.
